description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractUserRoleManager within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Authorization Manager module. It provides a base interface and partial implementation for managing user roles, permissions, and access control in the HR management system. The class includes methods for role checking, permission retrieval, workflow actions, and data group permissions, intended to be extended by concrete implementations.

classes.name: AbstractUserRoleManager
classes.description: An abstract class providing a blueprint for managing user roles, permissions, and access control in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve and verify user permissions, roles, workflow actions, data groups, and module/page access, meant to be implemented by subclasses tailored to specific storage or business logic mechanisms.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the current user and computes their roles.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the currently set User object, or null if none is set.

methods.name: getUserRolesForAuthUser
methods.description: Returns the array of roles associated with the current user.

methods.name: userHasNonPredefinedRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has any roles that are not predefined.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve entities accessible by the user, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve IDs of accessible entities.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check if a specific entity is accessible.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to verify accessibility of multiple entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Abstract method to get properties of accessible entities.

methods.name: getAccessibleModules
methods.description: Abstract method to get list of modules the user can access.

methods.name: isModuleAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check module accessibility.

methods.name: isScreenAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method to check screen-level access rights.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve permissions for a screen.

methods.name: getApiPermissions
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve API access permissions.

methods.name: isFieldAccessible
methods.description: Abstract method for field-level access control.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve employees assigned to a specific role.

methods.name: computeUserRoles
methods.description: Abstract method to determine roles associated with a user, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Check if a specific workflow action is permitted for the user.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieve list of actions the user is allowed to perform in a workflow.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Given actions, return states where they can be applied.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Retrieve permissions for data groups, merging permissions if they exist, return default if not.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Get data group permissions collection, potentially filtered.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Get default page for a module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Get the user's home page.

methods.name: essRightsToOwnWorkflow
methods.description: Indicates if ESS (Employee Self Service) rights include own workflow rights. Defaults to true.
